name: SDK, Plugin System, and Trust Kernel
description: Ship the governed runtime contract: @tribunus/protocol (low-level schema package), @tribunus/client (TypeScript SDK), @tribunus/plugin (capability-scoped extension SDK), and the Trust Kernel security enforcement layer. Established by ADR 0018.
objective: Third-party plugins run in isolated extension host with capability-scoped handles only. No raw DB/filesystem/network access. All authority-relevant actions produce durable receipts. Trust Kernel enforces technical confinement, capability governance, provenance, and dharma overlay.
